d.seg: कितने दूँगा मैं? कितने दूँगा मैं आपको? 300 रुपये दूँगा, 400 रुपये दूँगा, 500 रुपये दूँगा.
d.tr: How much will I give? How much will I give you? I will give 300 rupees, 400 rupees, 500 rupees.
d.j: The user is explicitly offering money in a suggestive context, implying a transactional exchange for services.
